Lena Ortiz: heads-up: yesterday a tiny flag change accidentally expanded routing for /v2/embed to some internal tenants; quotas got misapplied. can we add a fast 'scope diff' in console that shows which quota sets would be touched?
Marcus Bell: yes. minimal surface: list of quota_set_ids + affected routes + delta tokens/hr. show top-3 impacted customers.
Tara Nguyen: also include a quick risk heuristic: if any affected quota is on a low-capacity pool, mark as high risk.
Lena Ortiz: UX: when clicking Promote, show 'Scope diff' panel with approx coverage and quota hits. allow user to 'run validation' which queues a runtime sample job.
Marcus Bell: API sketch: POST /api/v1/configs/{id}/scope-diff {"seed":"s1","sample_fraction":0.01} -> returns artifact_id, approx_coverage, affected_quota_ids.
PreviewBot: validation job 2876543210 queued by @Lena Ortiz -> running -> completed. result: approx_coverage=2.8%, validated_coverage=2.6%, impacted_quota_ids=[QS-12,QS-21], est_tokens_hr=+7.4k, highest_risk=QS-21
Tara Nguyen: gating: block promotion if validated_coverage > 5% OR any impacted quota on 'low-capacity' pool. allow force with two approvers. log artifact id and reason.
Marcus Bell: followups: add console filter to preview only for routes matching prefix, and surface TTL for validation result.
Lena Ortiz: can someone own a tiny RFC for sample caps and default thresholds? I'll coordinate with support for customer notify if a promo touches real accounts.
Marcus Bell: I'll draft RFC and add CI step to fail deploy when gate trips unless override flag present.
Lena Ortiz: thanks all, post updates in #eng-platform when RFC lands. :thumbsup:
